audience: website owners and support teams who chat with visitors in Chaport

useCases.title: Read a visitor's latest chat and summarize it
useCases.text: The AI lists visitors, opens a visitor's latest chat with its messages, stage and assigned operators, and tells you what the visitor asked.

useCases.title: Find visitors by contact data and chat activity
useCases.text: The AI lists visitors, most recent chat first, with name, email, phone, location, notes and UTM data, and opens one visitor for all contact data.

useCases.title: See which operators are online
useCases.text: The AI lists the operators with role, last activity and online status, and opens one operator for details.

useCases.title: Add a note or update a visitor's contact data
useCases.text: The AI changes a visitor's name, email, phone, notes, custom fields or email-marketing consent. Only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Reassign or close a visitor's latest chat
useCases.text: The AI assigns the latest chat to one operator or team, unassigns it, changes its stage, for example to close it, or flags it as missed.

useCases.title: Send a message to a visitor or set operator status
useCases.text: The AI sends a real message to a visitor as an operator after you confirm the text, or sets an operator's status such as away for a set time.
